body: Acceptance attempt 3 one-shot `npm test` failed only `conflictsOpen.test.ts` PATHEXT safety at the unchanged 15s timeout (11,155 other tests passed). The test performs 13 sequential `openInEditor` calls; each re-runs Git conflict discovery while the full Windows suite contends for processes. The new Windows `maxWorkers: 8` cap was insufficient. Do not rerun this attempt. A future retry must first remove this avoidable repeated Git work or lower Windows process concurrency, then run the full gate once.
